summary: On OpenShift the operator scales replicas down and uses termination_grace_period_seconds to drain jobs from task pods first, and vertical changes roll out new pods with new requests and limits; on VM-based and containerized installs both need an inventory update and installer re-run that halts the platform, and resizing VMs may need shutdown.
questions: How do I scale down automation controller task pods without killing jobs?
Do I need to re-run the installer after resizing an AAP VM?
What does termination_grace_period_seconds do when scaling?
